Welcome to the research website of **E-Motioner-X-SBS**, the computational biophysics research group of Shuvam Banerji Seal at IISER Kolkata.

## About

This website serves as a central hub for research progress, blog posts, and documentation of ongoing work in computational biophysics, machine learning for protein folding, and quantum chemistry.

## Research Areas

- **Biomolecular Hamiltonians** — Computing effective Hamiltonians for biological macromolecules
- **Contact Mapping** — Deriving contact maps from interaction data
- **ML for Protein Folding** — Deep learning models for structure prediction
- **Manning Condensation** — Counterion condensation theory for polyelectrolytes
- **Magnus Expansion** — Time-evolution formalism for biomolecular systems
